purpose.summary: This is a medical billing calculation subprogram for the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard receipt software. It computes patient co-payment amounts and hospitalization fees (入院料 = inpatient fees) for Japanese national health insurance claims. The program handles complex insurance combination rules, elderly patient co-payments, emergency transport fees, and various local government subsidy calculations.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — standalone batch subprogram
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Large OCCURS tables for daily inpatient fee classification (WRK-NYUINDAY-TABLE, WRK-HANBETU-TABLE, etc.)
63 CALL statements indicating heavy use of external subprograms
No COMP-3 packed decimal despite financial calculations
Long revision history spanning 2002–2012 with named developers (NACL team)
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in EUC-JP Japanese but was decoded as latin-1, causing all Japanese text in comments and data names to appear as mojibake. The program is clearly a production-grade medical billing calculation module from the well-known open-source Japanese ORCA medical receipt system. The 371 KB size and 7606 lines confirm substantial production complexity. No copybooks (COPY count = 0) suggests all definitions are inline or the copybooks were already expanded.
